officialSources.observation: Municipal SIT page identifies the Autoridad Catastral Municipal as the source of cadastral information, links to the municipal cadastral map, and describes lookup by cadastral code or address.
Government of La Paz cadastral map page embeds the public map client at https://sitservicios.lapaz.bo/SITOL/msitolpre.html.
Public municipal map client points to the cadastral GeoServer and includes a WMS lot layer; following its public configuration exposed the feature service.
Municipal GeoServer WFS capabilities response identifies provider GAMLP and exposes lot feature types including catastro:lotesCertificados, catastro:lotes2, and catastro:lotes.

application/xml; WFS names include catastro:lotesCertificados and other municipal lot layers.
